=== DOCS-TRUTH RE-PINNED (verified against trino.io/docs/467 mental model) ===
• Iceberg OPTIMIZE — `EXECUTE optimize(file_size_threshold => '256MB')` is the Trino 467 form. Unit-suffixed DataSize literal ('128MB', '256MB', '512MB') — NEVER bare bytes integer. Optional `WHERE <partition_predicate>` to scope (only partition columns; non-partition predicates rejected). Procedure has ONE arg (`file_size_threshold`); no `sort_order`/`strategy`/`target_file_size`/`where`-as-param. Spark equivalent is `CALL iceberg.system.rewrite_data_files(table => '...', options => map('target-file-size-bytes', '268435456'))` — different procedure name + bytes-integer in the options map.
• ANALYZE — Trino 467 syntax is `ANALYZE <catalog>.<schema>.<table>` (NO `TABLE` keyword) optionally `WITH (columns = ARRAY['c1', 'c2'])`. Writes Puffin `.stats` file in MinIO next to table metadata. Drives CBO join-order + join-distribution decisions. EXPLAIN shows plan+cost. Re-run periodically (stats don't auto-update). DO NOT confuse with EXPLAIN ANALYZE (separate command that executes the query and reports per-operator runtime stats).
• OPA / JWT multi-tenant — OPA (Open Policy Agent) is the prod authorization backend (`access-control.name=opa` per prod_info.md). JWT tenant_id claim binds the user to a tenant. Row-filter injection comes from OPA's decision payload (applied by Trino's filter/mask hooks) OR from per-tenant `CREATE VIEW ... SECURITY DEFINER AS SELECT ... WHERE tenant_id = '...'` with REVOKE on base table. Central enforcement (OPA + DEFINER view) — NEVER rely on every analyst remembering to append `WHERE tenant_id = ?`. Specific policy rules deferred to external governance doc (not in repo).
• MERGE INTO — Trino 467 form: `MERGE INTO target USING source ON ... WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET col = ..., col = ... WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (cols) VALUES (...)`. EXPLICIT column lists on both branches — NO `UPDATE SET *` / `INSERT *` star-shorthand (Spark/Delta/Snowflake-only). NO `WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE` (Spark/Snowflake-only). MERGE on Iceberg connector ON by default (no flag). MERGE on PostgreSQL connector NOT SUPPORTED on Trino 467 (added in 470 with flag, transactional only in 475+).
• MATCH_RECOGNIZE — Trino 467 funnel/sequential-pattern form: `<table_or_subquery> MATCH_RECOGNIZE ( PARTITION BY ... ORDER BY ... MEASURES ... AS ... ONE ROW PER MATCH AFTER MATCH SKIP TO NEXT ROW PATTERN (label1 label2+ label3+) DEFINE label1 AS <pred>, label2 AS <pred>, ... )`. Supported in Trino, Snowflake, Oracle; NOT in Postgres/MySQL/BigQuery/DuckDB.
